title: Solid body
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. This ensures that the origin point is aligned with the global coordinate system. Next, draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In the first loop, draw the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.0268, 0.0), then draw the second line from (0.0268, 0.0) to (0.0268, 0.0625). Continue by drawing the third line from (0.0268, 0.0625) to (0.0, 0.0625), and finally, draw the fourth line from (0.0, 0.0625) back to the origin (0.0, 0.0). After completing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.0625 to the entire two-dimensional sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into a three-dimensional object by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero degrees and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Finally, extrude the two-dimensional sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a solid rectangular section. Ensure that the extrusion does not extend in the opposite direction. The resulting solid body has a length of 0.026785714285714288 units, a width of 0.0625 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0268, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0268, 0.0625) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0625) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular prism
r = r.extrude(0.75)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)

import cadquery as cq

# Create the rectangular bar with slightly rounded vertical edges
w = 0.0268   # X width
d = 0.0625   # Y depth
h = 0.75     # Z height
r_fillet = 0.004  # small corner radius

r = cq.Workplane("XY") \
    .rect(w, d) \
    .extrude(h) \
    .edges("|Z") \
    .fillet(r_fillet)
